mapper.select: select title_k, audience_rating from movie where screening_f = '1' and remove_f='N' order by movie_num
select main_image, title_k from movie where instr(#{ title_k }, title_k) > 0
select TO_CHAR(sc_date, 'YYYY.MM.DD(dy)') AS sc_date_str from(select to_date(#{ sc_date_str }, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sc_date from dual)
select distinct sc_date from screening_info where sc_date=to_date(#{ sc_date_str }, 'YYYY.MM.DD(dy)')
select distinct th_num, m.title_k from screening_info sc, movie m where sc.movie_num=(select movie_num from movie where title_k = #{ title_k }) and title_k = #{ title_k } order by th_num

select sc_num, th_num, sc_date, to_char(sc_time, 'HH24:MI') as sc_time_str, to_char(sc_end_time, 'HH24:MI') as sc_end_time_str, (th_total_seat - people) as total_seat, category from (select sc.sc_num, sc.th_num, sc.movie_num, sc_date, sc_time, sc_end_time, th_total_seat, nvl(people, 0) as people, category from screening_info sc, th_seat th, theater, reservation re where sc.th_num = th.th_num(+) and th.th_num = theater.th_num(+) and sc.sc_num = re.sc_num(+)) where movie_num=#{ movie_num } and sc_date=#{ sc_date } order by sc_num
